arlish_0.m: Hello. I'm Arlish, the proprietor. This is a general store, so I sell some of this, some of that, and a little bit of the other. Would you like to see what I have?
r: The teacher said that you would give me a cake.
The teacher said that you would give me a cake.
What can you tell me about Lawellyn's dagger?
I want to talk about the investigation.
I need to find a large empty bottle. Do you have one?

arlish_10.m: Sure. You must have done something very good. Wait a second...

arlish_12.m: Shall I cut it for you?
r: No, thank you. I prefer the cake as a whole.

arlish_14.m: I'm afraid you'll get a stomachache if you eat the whole cake at once. But well - here you have it.

arlish_16.m: Well, I'm cutting the cake into 8 large pieces. I hope they taste good to you!

arlish_asd_0.m: Why?  What do you know about it?
r: Well, I have it right here.
Well, I have it right here.
You have looked at the dagger. Can you tell me more?
I was just curious, I was told that a dagger I had was Lawellyn's, but I no longer have it.
Nothing. I was just curious. Bye.
I'm sorry, but I was not able to find any new information that would determine what happened to your father.
I'm still investigating. I'll come back when I have more information.
I have some good news for you.

arlish_asd_110.m: I'm sorry too. Thank you for trying.

arlish_asd_120.m: I should have known that it was Ogea!  He never agreed with my father's decision about the land.

arlish_asd_130.m: It would be my honor if you take Lawellyn's dagger.  He would want you to have it.
r: Thank you, but it was my honor to help bring you closure and justice.

arlish_asd_140.m: I know you do.  I heard that you found my father's murderer.

arlish_asd_15.m: Well, he did have a dagger, but I can't say if the one you had was his if I can't look at it.

arlish_asd_20.m: Arlish takes the dagger and examines it while you continue to talk.
r: I was able to acquire the dagger and its gem. Then Edrin repaired it for me.

arlish_asd_30.m: This can't be it. It looks like my father's dagger, but his dagger has been missing for a couple of years now. I believe this is stolen property!
r: So what.  You said it has been missing for years, so how would you know?

arlish_asd_40.m: You see, this was my father Lawellyn's most prized possession. He kept it with him always.

arlish_asd_50.m: Then one night, father did not come to my place for dinner as was the custom.  I quickly became worried that something terrible had happened to him. So I went to Mustura for help, but she quickly pushed it off as 'Lawellyn simply went on a trip'.

arlish_asd_60.m: But I tried to explain to her that Lawellyn would not do so without telling me.

arlish_asd_70.m: Indeed it does.  In fact, I fear he was murdered. Will you help?
r: Yes.  Of course I will go investigate a little.  You are in need.
I'm sorry, but I just don't have the time.

arlish_bottle_1.m: Well, that's an unusual request. What would you need such a thing for?
r: Seviron at the church needs it. I'm just helping out.
Nevermind. If you don't have one you should just say so. I'll look elsewhere.

arlish_bottle_2.m: Well, I do happen to have one. I don't display it as shop inventory because I've never been asked for such a thing before. Since it's for the church, you can have it for free.

If I can find the gem he can remount it in the dagger, and the dagger will have special properties. Apparently it used to belong to someone named Lawellyn.

brv_dagger.100: I collected the repaired dagger from Edrin. Apparently there was something mysterious about Lawellyn's death. I should ask people in town to find out more.

brv_dagger.110: I've found a gravestone that told me that Lawellyn was related to Arlish. I should try to find her.
brv_dagger.115: Arlish couldn't tell me anything about the dagger because I no longer have it.

brv_dagger.130: I decided to help Arlish by investigating Lawellyn's disappearance.

brv_dagger.160: I should take the evidence to Kizzo.

brv_dagger.180: After speaking with Venanra, I learned that the glove belonged to Ogea.
